Why do we need to play M/A’s game and legislate this stuff despite longstanding precedent?
I always found the gnome convention to be a little silly even for NationStates, enshrining it into law isn't something that I want to do.
Changed the channel name: GA - Committee Qualifications
I, for one, welcome our new dolphin overlords.
Changed the channel name: [Next] GA - Committee Qualifications
I actually dont get what this resolution is about - my gameplayer brain cannot comprehwnd
Is it seeking to classify all our WA staff as gnomes?
Changed the channel name: [At Vote] GA - Committee Qualifications
It's recreating a part of the Committee rule that Ballo has decided not to enforce.

Okay:

Wayyyyy back in the day, moderators ruled that players can't decide who staffs WA committees. They said it was magical gnomes that spring into existence when committees are created. 

This became the roleplay convention for years. 

Last month, Ballotonia issued a ruling saying players *can* decide who staffs committees. 

Bisofeyr's proposal here is attempting to use a resolution to basically reinstate the previous gnome RP convention.
Changed the channel name: [Concluded] GA - Committee Qualifications
